hswm-cell0-causal-decision-experiment-20.algorithm: Pre-design only: frozen LLM cells=3, irreducible ternary operator synapse=1, bounded recurrence=1; equal-budget operator/scalar/shuffle/removal/full-context/strongest-cell controls; require outcome-later-W mediation, rollback and macro-cell behavioral preservation.
hswm-cell0-causal-decision-experiment-20.author: codex-hswm-cellular-formalization
hswm-cell0-causal-decision-experiment-20.comment: HSWM-CELL-0 is the smallest proposed falsifier for semantic operator weight and self-similar composition. This node records a positive heuristic, not a preregistered prediction or result.
hswm-cell0-causal-decision-experiment-20.limitation: Thresholds and dataset sealing still require a separate preregistration before execution.

hswm-cellular-metaneural-definition-2026.algorithm: Materialize the literal USER_PRIMARY cellular statement and the secondary mathematical definition without submitting a metric, prediction, or verdict.
hswm-cellular-metaneural-definition-2026.author: codex-hswm-cellular-formalization
hswm-cellular-metaneural-definition-2026.comment: HSWM is a self-similar plastic metaneural system: typed stateful logical LLM cells execute as semantic functions; operator-valued n-ary synapses transform tail outputs into head inputs; recurrent outcomes can alter fast/slow W and topology; the whole realized network can expose the same open-cell interface. Source: DEFINITION_HSWM_CELLULAR_METANEURAL_SYSTEM_2026-07-26.md.
hswm-cellular-metaneural-definition-2026.limitation: Definition and interface closure are not evidence that the seven LargerAIConditions hold in a runtime.

hswm-cellular-runtime-gap-map-20260726.algorithm: Separate exact structure, partial engineering materialization, confounded causal evidence and unproven conjunctions.
hswm-cellular-runtime-gap-map-20260726.author: codex-hswm-cellular-formalization
hswm-cellular-runtime-gap-map-20260726.comment: Current map: OpenHSWM composition is STRUCTURAL_EXACT; logical cell execution, scalar semantic weight, candidate snapshot and recurrent event state are PARTIAL; topology learning evidence is CONFOUNDED; the integrated three-clock runtime and the seven LargerAIConditions remain UNPROVEN. No progress verdict is minted.
hswm-cellular-runtime-gap-map-20260726.limitation: Current negative or confounded evidence must not be erased by definition work.

Q-hswm-cell0-operator-causal-mediation.body: With three frozen typed LLM cells, one irreducible ternary operator synapse and one bounded recurrent episode, does outcome-later learned W improve fresh frozen behavior beyond scalar, shuffle, removal, strongest-cell and full-context controls, with exact rollback removing at least 70 percent of the gain?
Q-hswm-cell0-operator-causal-mediation.name: Q-hswm-cell0-operator-causal-mediation

Q-hswm-consolidation-and-exception-reten.body: Can fast episodic weight changes consolidate into slow semantic operators while preserving rare exceptions, avoiding catastrophic forgetting and remaining exactly rollbackable?
Q-hswm-consolidation-and-exception-reten.name: Q-hswm-consolidation-and-exception-retention

Q-hswm-larger-ai-seven-condition-conjunc.body: Can one sealed programme jointly establish persistent macro-state, closed outcome-credit-DeltaW, W mediation, topology mediation, transcript-free A-to-B transfer, strongest-cell/full-context superiority, and retention/rollback?
Q-hswm-larger-ai-seven-condition-conjunc.name: Q-hswm-larger-ai-seven-condition-conjunction

Q-hswm-macrocell-behavioral-closure.body: After hiding internal state and exposing the three-cell motif as one macro-cell, is public typed behavior preserved under composition without relying on fixed depth labels or private-state leakage?
Q-hswm-macrocell-behavioral-closure.name: Q-hswm-macrocell-behavioral-closure

Q-hswm-topology-causal-mediation.body: Can a one-class topology mutation pass fresh, retention, complexity and canary gates and lose its gain under exact learned-edge removal, unlike the current confounded class-tag lookup?
Q-hswm-topology-causal-mediation.name: Q-hswm-topology-causal-mediation

Q-hswm-weight-only-agent-transfer.body: Can only Agent A's accepted semantic-weight packet improve a byte-frozen Agent B on component-disjoint unseen work without transcript, prompt, parameter or cache leakage?
Q-hswm-weight-only-agent-transfer.name: Q-hswm-weight-only-agent-transfer
